tools.note: Twelve @agent.tool functions cover Jira and local task DB reads/writes plus utility operations.

authority.fact: Interactive CLI user input reaches agent.run_sync.
The agent can create Jira tickets, add Jira comments and open Jira issues in a browser.
The agent can read and write the local task database and archive tasks.
Jira credentials come from environment variables rather than literals.

policy_expectations.reason: Multiple state-changing Jira/local task tools have no human approval boundary.
Privileged external/local data-write tools are directly model-callable without approval/guardrail.
The same agent combines Jira/task data reads with state-changing writes.
Untrusted interactive CLI input can drive destructive/state-changing operations including task archival and external Jira mutation.

unresolved: Jira server destination is environment-configured but not model-selected; no broad-network finding is asserted.
